sources.clean: Zantedeschia Spreng., Syst. Veg.  3:765.  1826.  Bailey, Stand. Cycl. Hort. 6: 3534. 1917; C. Letty in Bothalia, 11: 5-26. 1973. [nom. cons.] Richardia Kunth Rhizomatous herbs. Leaves usually sagittate or hastate, sometimes spotted, long petioled. Spathe large and conspicuous, cuspidate. Spadix monoecious, with male flowers above. Perianth absent. Fruit a 1-3-loculed berry. 8-9 species, tropical and S. Africa. Represented in Pakistan by 1 cultivated species.
